item.title: J-K Assembly: BJP legislators stage sit-in, demand apology by CM
item.description: Jammu, Feb 11 : BJP legislators on Wednesday trooped into the well of the Jammu and Kashmir Assembly and staged a sit-in to press for Chief Minister Omar Abdullah’s apology over his “unparliamentary remarks” against them. This happened shortly after the BJP members, barring Leader of Opposition Sunil Sharma, returned to the House at the end of the Question Hour after staging a walkout on the issue earlier. item.title: 31 Residential Colonies regularised in Jammu, process now stayed by HC: J-K CM
item.description: Jammu, Feb 11: The process of regularisation of residential colonies in Jammu was initiated earlier and the Jammu Development Authority has already regularised 31 colonies, but the process was later stayed by the high court, Chief Minister Omar Abdullah said on Wednesday. item.title: 19-Year-Old dies by Suicide in Jammu Kashmir
item.description: Srinagar,Feb 12: A 19-year-old youth allegedly died by suicide after hanging himself at his residence in the Thatha Rounda area of Bhaderwah in Doda district of Jammu and Kashmir during the intervening night of Wednesday and Thursday, officials said. item.description: Srinagar,Feb 12: Thirty-three Kashmiri students enrolled at Mewar University in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, have been suspended after protesting against the alleged absence of mandatory approvals for the BSc Nursing course. item.title: Over 1400 illegal structures Demolished across J-K since October 2024: Govt
item.description: Jammu, Feb 12: A total of 1,425 illegal structures, including residential, have been razed across Jammu and Kashmir since the formation of the National Conference-led government in October 2024, the Assembly was informed on Thursday. item.description: Jammu, Feb 12: The Jammu and Kashmir Road Transport Corporation has recently proposed the procurement of 200 additional electric buses under the prime minister e-drive scheme, according to a government statement.
